caption: The video captures a close view of a round metal fire pit in a backyard, with a white picket fence, pale house, and hanging tire swing in the background. Several dark, dome-shaped charred pieces rest on a grey concrete block at the center, while crumpled black paper lies to the right, white ash to the left, and a labeled white roll sits in the foreground. Bright orange-yellow flames rise continuously from the charred pieces throughout the clip, already burning at the first frame. The flames flicker constantly, repeatedly changing height, width, and shape, surging into tall vertical tongues at some moments and collapsing into shorter, right-leaning licks at others. The brightness and extent of the burning on the charred pieces vary frame by frame as the fire surges and recedes. Thin wisps of smoke appear intermittently above the flames near the top edge. The charred pieces, block, roll, paper pile, ash, and background fence, house, and swing all remain fixed, with no object translation or deformation. The camera stays static, and the fire is still burning as the clip ends.
